spans.s: लृट् a general term for the general affix ल् of the second future which is applied in the sense of future time in general, without any specific conditions, the affixes ति, त:, अन्ति being substituted for the ल् and the sign (vikaraņa) स्य being added to the root; cf.
. The terminations अत् and अान are substituted for the affix लृट् to form future participles; e.g. भवि- ष्यत्, एधिष्यमाण, cf. लृट; सद्वा
